Name: Call me Husband RRRR Pronouns Patch
Author: nuupon
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/QgZsM7L.png[/img]﻿

Simple mod I made for personal use, changes the gender neutral terms for male farmers in the Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp mod to be he/him, husband, etc. With permission from the author I upload this and maintain it as RRRR patches and is updated.

If anyone would like he/him to be added for feminine farmers I can also do that.

This is just the i18n translation folder, so just add and replace!

I wouldn't say I am new to modding as I've done it for years, but this is my first time sharing publicly so please be gentle in comments with any issues or requests, thank you!
[/size][/center][center]side note; this changes some of the default dialogue to be male specific so do not download this if you want to be referred to they/them or she/her.[/center]
